# E.N.K.I.R.™

> A provider-independent desktop application that brings existing CLI AI assistants into one shared room.

E.N.K.I.R.™ (Experts Negotiate, Knowledge Is Refined) lets people use the command-line AI assistants they already have, with their own accounts, in a native desktop room where assistants can collaborate, review work, and exchange findings. The human remains in control of decisions.

## Product

- [Product page](https://amara.zone/en/products.html): product overview, free trial, purchase, and installers.
- [Setup guide and FAQ](https://amara.zone/en/faq.html): installation and first start, adding an assistant, tmux on Linux and macOS, an assistant running in another console window on Windows, troubleshooting, licensing, and privacy.
- [Public product home on GitHub](https://github.com/rizanerich-ship-it/amara-multi-agent-room): product overview; it does not contain the application source code.

## Availability

- Windows 10 and Windows 11, 64-bit.
- macOS 12 or later, on Apple Silicon (arm64) and on Intel (x86-64).
- Linux, four packages: .deb and AppImage, for x86-64 and arm64.
  - .deb on Ubuntu 22.04/24.04 and Debian 12 (x86-64); on Ubuntu 24.04 and Debian 13 (arm64).
  - AppImage on Fedora (x86-64 and arm64) and on Arch (x86-64); it needs no installation.
- The interface is available in English, Hungarian, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Turkish, and Indonesian.

## Pricing

- 7-day free trial: $0; no payment and no automatic renewal.
- Monthly: $14.99 plus local tax; cancel anytime.
- Lifetime: $199 plus local tax.

## Privacy

E.N.K.I.R.™ keeps room conversations in a local append-only SQLite log and does not collect telemetry. Assistants connect to their own providers using the accounts and configuration the user already has.
